    i = 2
    while i * i <= x:

            return False
        i += 1
    return True

if k == 0:

    for _ in range(1, p):

num = [0] * (p + 1)

def dfs(x, st):
    cnt = 1
    while True:
        x = (k * x) % p
        v[x] = 1
        cnt += 1
        if x == st:

    num[cnt] += 1

for i in range(p):

vec = [i for i in range(1, p + 1) if num[i] > 0]

ans = 1
for i in range(len(vec)):

    for j in range(len(vec)):
        if vec[j] * vec[j] > vec[i]:
            break
        if vec[i] % vec[j] == 0:
            a = vec[i] // vec[j]
            b = vec[j]
            t += a * num[a]
            if a != b:
                t += b * num[b]
            t %= MOD
    for _ in range(num[vec[i]]):
        ans = (ans * t) % MOD

print(ans)
